A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. All 22 pages of each version, including figures, tables, equations, and Appendix A.1–A.9, support reliable comparison despite changes in naming.

before.justification: v2 reports original SOP-prediction and dialogue-generation experiments in Tables 4–5, human evaluations in Figure 4, and cost-effectiveness results in Appendix A.6.

after.justification: v3 retains these original automatic, human-evaluation, and cost-effectiveness results, including the appendix analyses.

M1.justification: PCA is renamed ChatSOP, and MCTS+SOP becomes SOP-guided MCTS (SGM). The offline planning procedures, online search stages, reward calculation, prompt bodies, and Algorithm 1 in Appendix A.9 remain unchanged.

E1.justification: The dataset is renamed from ChatSOP to SOPDAIL, but retains the same Chinese dialogues, 32 domains, 53 tasks, and 3,114 dialogues. SOP prediction, dialogue generation, and the task inventory in Table 6 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 4 retains DAL comparisons with TCoT and SFT; Table 5 retains CoT and CoT+SOP comparisons with the proposed planner. The ToT and ToT+SOP comparisons in Figure 4 are also unchanged. SGM replaces the MCTS+SOP label without changing comparator membership.

E3.justification: The task-level splits in Table 3, five-fold cross-validation, evaluated model configurations, metrics, and 100-dialogue human evaluation remain the same. Training, generation, and search settings in Section 6.2 and Appendix A.4 are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the tree-search and SOP comparisons, identity-verification and persuasion case studies in Figure 4, and cost-effectiveness analysis in Appendix A.6/Figure 12. No ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Annotation agreement statistics and statistical reporting practices remain unchanged. Both versions report the same point estimates without introducing experimental seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results in Tables 4–5 and plotted results in Figures 4 and 12 are unchanged, as are the qualitative examples and findings. For example, GPT-3.5 turn accuracy remains 76.52 for the proposed method; only its label changes from MCTS+SOP to SGM.

T1.justification: The SOP definitions, problem formulation, Equations 1–9, and mathematical content of Algorithm 1 are unchanged. The revised algorithm caption and added cross-reference introduce no new derivation, assumption, or proof.

C1.justification: The title, abstract, and introduction foreground SOP-guided MCTS more explicitly, but retain the same dataset novelty, controllability objective, planning contributions, and performance claims. The conclusion is unchanged; the revised emphasis describes the existing contribution.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning SOP control, proactive persuasion through search, model size, generalization, and computational cost are retained. The hallucination and runtime limitations and proposed mitigations are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hardware, annotation instructions, appendix prompts, and the stated code/data access link are unchanged. The new reference to Algorithm 1 in Appendix A.9 points to material already present in v2.

R1.justification: The references and substantive comparisons with prior dialogue planning and MCTS reasoning work remain unchanged. Substitutions such as 'SOP-based' with 'SOP-guided' do not alter the research positioning.

P1.justification: v3 revises the title and portions of the abstract and introduction, propagates the framework/dataset/planner renamings, replaces some conversational-agent terminology, and adds an algorithm cross-reference. Section organization remains intact. The renaming is incomplete: Section 4 still reads 'The ChatSOP Dataset' while its text uses SOPDAIL.

P2.justification: Figures 1 and 3 receive revised planner labels and captions, including explicit node/edge annotations in Figure 3. Table labels reflect the renamings, and appendix prompt boxes and spacing are adjusted. No result figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v3 mainly renames and relabels the existing work while preserving its methods, evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations. More explicit diagram labels and the added algorithm reference provide small clarity gains, but the dataset rename introduces an inconsistency in Section 4. These limited editorial changes do not establish a meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
